title: Procedure Selection Under Interference
claimTested: After learning similarly shaped procedures, Spoon retrieves the procedure named by the request and does not substitute a merely available one.

phases.purpose: Teach the existing florp procedure in a dedicated Teacher-ON turn.

input.prompt: A florp operation means multiply a number by three and add one.

criteria: records or acknowledges a reusable florp procedure

phases.purpose: Teach the existing zorp procedure separately, so both procedures are available before recall is tested.

input.prompt: ZORP(x) means 10 divided by (x minus 5). Zorp 8 is valid.

criteria: records the zorp procedure and its valid example

phases.purpose: Recall florp with zorp present, without Teacher assistance.
Recall zorp with florp present, using a valid input.
Confirm that the presence of florp does not bypass zorp's invalid boundary.

criteria: does not execute division by zero
